stages.name: raw-record
stages.claim: The raw record: the update toward the source against the discrepancy, one dot per event, in three kinds of panel: a known source, a latent source in a six-group, and a cosponsorship network.

stages.name: baseline
stages.claim: The best model without latent mechanisms is pulled toward zero by the no-move mass.

stages.name: empirical-mean
stages.claim: The empirical conditional mean sits above the baseline at large discrepancy: the kernel-only fit under-reads influence.

stages.name: influence-arm
stages.claim: Conditioning on the retention gate and the attended source unmixes a steeper influence arm; the band is a 95% interval from the observed information.

stages.name: retention-arm
stages.claim: The retention arm is flat near the baseline opinion; the estimated gate probability is 0.86 on TAKACS-S2-control and 0.75 on VK-gauging, and SENATE's selected model has no gate.
